Slot index: 'mov edi,[0x88fd00]; inc edi; cmp edi,1; jle; mov edi,0' then '[edi*4+0x88fc98]' etc. - the only writer is 0x519ccd 'mov [0x88fd00],edi' with edi 0 or 1 (a raw scan of .text finds no other store or pointer to it; image value 0), so it is drawn {0, 1} (edi 1 and, through the jle fall-through, 0); a random value below -1 gave v2's wild index fault at 0x519c01. The 2-entry tables 0x88fc98, 0x88fca8, 0x88fcb8 and 0x88fccc are never written (image 0x1000/0x1000, 0x8c2/0x832, 0x4c78/0x3314, 0xc00/0xa00; the scan finds only the reads in this function): drawn from the image values and other values in 0..0xfffff, which keeps both unsigned divides in range - 'mov eax,[fc98]; imul [fcb8]; shrd eax,edx,0xe' is then < 2^26, so 'mul [ebx+0x94]' (<= 0xffff, car_00519bb2) has edx < 0x3a98 for 'div 0x3a98', and ecx >= 0x100 (the 'cmp ecx,0x100; jge' floor) with 'mov eax,[fca8]; mul [fc98]' < 2^40 gives edx < 0x100 <= ecx for 'div ecx' (random products overflowed it in v2: the faults/timeouts at 0x519c3f). [0x88fccc] only feeds 'imul; shrd' (any i32). Then 'imul dword [0x7ad8b8]; mov ebp,[0x6f2c00]; cmp ebp,[0x7ad8b8]; jge; mov ebp,[0x7ad8b8]; test ebp,-1; jne; mov ebp,1; idiv ebp': [0x7ad8b8] is a non-negative game rate (image 0xa3d; also the unsigned divisor of 0x4813eb 'div dword [0x7ad8b8]'), and for S >= 0 the quotient (eax*S)/max(c00,S) never overflows (|q| <= |eax|, or the dividend is 0 when S = 0), so S is drawn 0..0xffff with 0 and the image value listed; [0x6f2c00] (stored from 0x54e6af by 0x51d9c8/0x521229) is any i32, often <= 0 so S = 0 with c00 <= 0 reaches 'mov ebp,1'. [0x88fc78] (0 or an unsigned quotient clamped by 'cmp eax,0x40000000; jle' in 0x518f17, so it can also be negative) is drawn 0 (both arms of 'test [0x88fc78],-1'), small/large positives near the computed level for both sides of 'cmp eax,[0x88fc78]; jl', 0x40000000 and -1. The owner slots 0x88fd04/0x88fd08 ('cmp esi,[edi*4+0x88fd04]; je'; the game stores esi or 0 there) equal the spec's esi in about half the cases each. [0x6f3b79] ('cmp byte,0xff; jne') {0xff, 0, 1}; Behind 'test byte [0x66d7a4],0xff; je' (overriding gate_0051ae76's mostly-zero draw: {0, 0, 1, 0x80, 0xff}) 'mov eax,[0x88fce4]; cmp eax,[0x88fcdc]; jl' exits: [0x88fce4] is a level (0x4000 stored by the caller 0x51935b, or 0x518f17's computed value), [0x88fcdc] is never written (image 0x4b00; only this read), both drawn around 0x4b00 and at the signed extremes so the jl goes both ways (v3 dry run missed 0x519c9a:taken). The start arm's 0x518bff/0x518c3e read the 129-entry volume table 0x7a8eec ('mov edx,[edx*4+0x7a8eec]' after clamping the index to 0..0x80), which 0x518a9a fills at start-up with fistp results + 0xffffd8f0 (-10000..0) and which is only pushed to the back-end stubs: drawn as i32 -10000..0. Sample entries 0x12/0x13 of the 0x1c-byte records 0xb1c8e8 (dwords 0xb1cae0/0xb1cafc: 0x51f27f 'cmp dword [eax],0; je -> clc' for [0x88f6cc] = edi+0x12) drawn {0, 0, 1, 0x8000} so both outcomes of 'jae 0x519d6f' run.
